analytic_audit.mathematical_invariant: With all five component logits, locations, and scales initialized identically, permutation symmetry gives every same-role component the same gradient. The five components therefore remain on the identical-component invariant subspace apart from unprincipled floating-point noise.
analytic_audit.effective_model: one logistic component duplicated five times rather than an identifiable five-component mixture

scientific_conclusion: V44 cannot test whether a query-local five-component likelihood repairs the common-domain failure because its zero final initialization makes all five mixture components exchangeable and dynamically identical.
The defect was found from the frozen architecture and likelihood equations before the first predeclared validation diagnostic, not from development performance.

V45 may preserve every V44 input, split, loss, schedule, donor rank, evaluation threshold, and firewall, changing only the component-identifying initialization and the preflight needed to prove that distinct components receive distinct gradients.
